title: Every Vowel Is Two Numbers
summary: Drag a point around a plane of two resonant frequencies and it names a vowel. The chart phoneticians draw is that plane, and a tube of air explains it.

sources.title: Peterson and Barney, Control Methods Used in a Study of the Vowels (JASA, 1952)
Gunnar Fant, Acoustic Theory of Speech Production (1960)
Kenneth Stevens, Acoustic Phonetics (1998) — two-tube models
